name: toast
description: A transient notification stacked bottom-right of the viewport, built on Base UI Toast. One Provider + Viewport around the app; everything fires through useToast() (add, close, update, promise). Five types carried by a leading intent glyph — the surface never tints. Toasts collapse into a stack of three, clamped to the frontmost height, and expand on viewport hover or focus. The viewport landmark label and the close button's accessible name are required at the type level.

files.content:
/** Typed documentation for Toast (CONVENTIONS §11). */

export const toastDoc = {
  name: "Toast",
  status: "stable",
  summary:
    "A transient notification generated by the app, stacked bottom-right of the viewport. Built on Base UI Toast (ADR 0012): the queue, timers, stacking measurements, swipe gesture and announcement come from there; the API, anatomy and every pixel are the sheet's. Toasts collapse into a stack of three; hovering or focusing the viewport expands them.",

  anatomy: [
    { part: "viewport", slot: "toast-viewport", notes: "Fixed bottom-right, inset space-xl; width dialog-width-md capped to the viewport minus space-lg each side. A landmark region — F6 jumps to it — named by the required `label` prop." },
    { part: "root", slot: "toast", notes: "bg-elevated, a border-subtle hairline, radius-lg, shadow-lg. In dark the fill sits BELOW the page ground, so the hairline and shadow carry the boundary (ADR 0010). Height is clamped to the frontmost toast while collapsed." },
    { part: "content", slot: "toast-content", notes: "The padded row: p-lg, gap-md, overflow-hidden. Hidden (data-behind) while its toast is behind the front one; cross-fades back on expand." },
    { part: "icon", slot: "toast-icon", notes: "16px griddy glyph in a slot one title line tall (h-[1lh]), top-aligned so it centres on the first line however far the description wraps. Colour is the type's intent ink; the default type renders no icon. Loading renders Button's border-drawn spinner (slot toast-spinner)." },
    { part: "title", slot: "toast-title", notes: "16px bold in text-ink-primary. body-lg, NOT title-sm: the title roles are fluid (vw clamp) and a toast is a fixed 416px surface that does not follow the viewport — the browser test asserts the computed 16px." },
    { part: "description", slot: "toast-description", notes: "body-sm medium in text-ink-muted — Banner's message treatment. Carries the announcement when there is no title." },
    { part: "action", slot: "toast-action", notes: "Button — secondary · md, from `action: { label, onClick }`. At most one; pressing it runs onClick and then dismisses the toast." },
    { part: "close", slot: "toast-close", notes: "Banner's dismiss recipe: 24px hit area (SC 2.5.8) around a 16px Close glyph at full ink strength; hover tints the ground with currentColor at 10%. Named by the Viewport's required `dismissLabel`." },
  ],

  composition: `
Toast.Provider               limit? timeout?          — once, around the app
├─ <App/>                    anywhere below: useToast().add({ title, description, type, action })
└─ Toast.Viewport            label! dismissLabel! container?
   └─ (renders the stack — per-toast anatomy is not public API)
  `.trim(),

  props: {
    label: {
      type: "string",
      notes: "Required. Accessible name of the notifications landmark (the F6 target). A prop, not a default — every user-visible string is one (§9).",
    },
    dismissLabel: { type: "string", notes: "Required. Accessible name of every toast's close button." },
    container: {
      type: "HTMLElement | null",
      default: "document.body",
      notes: "Where the viewport is portalled. Theme tokens are INHERITED custom properties, so a viewport in the body leaves any brand scope on a wrapper and paints theme zero — pass the themed element to bring it back inside.",
    },
    limit: { type: "number", default: "3", notes: "Visible toasts before the oldest is hidden — kept mounted, inert, at opacity 0, so it can return if the stack shrinks." },
    timeout: { type: "number", default: "5000", notes: "Default auto-dismiss in ms; 0 never auto-dismisses. Paused while the viewport is hovered or focused and while the window is blurred (Base UI behaviour)." },
    "useToast()": {
      type: "() => ToastManager",
      notes: "add / close / update / promise, restated so no Base UI type reaches a consumer signature (ADR 0012). promise() runs one toast through loading → success/danger. add() with an existing id updates in place and resets the clock.",
    },
    type: {
      type: '"info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "loading"',
      notes: "Omit for the plain, glyph-less toast. The glyph is the ONLY thing intent changes — the surface never tints, so a stack of mixed types does not read as a traffic light. `danger` is this library's name (shared with Banner/Button); Base UI's promise() stamps `error`, which renders identically.",
    },
    action: {
      type: "{ label: string; onClick: () => void }",
      notes: "Rendered as Button secondary · md through Base UI's actionProps, so screen readers hear it with the announcement. Runs onClick, then dismisses — an action that should keep the toast open belongs on a surface with room for it.",
    },
    priority: { type: '"low" | "high"', default: '"low"', notes: "low announces politely; high assertively — reserve it for danger. Only the title and description strings are announced, so keep both plain text." },
  },

  do: [
    "Mount one Provider + Viewport at the app root and fire everything through useToast() — twelve call sites want exactly this shape.",
    "Give the description the detail and keep the title to a few words; the description carries the announcement when there is no title.",
    "Use promise() for async work — one toast updates through loading → success/danger instead of three stacking up.",
    "Pass the themed element as `container` when the app wraps a brand scope around part of the page.",
  ],

  dont: [
    "Do not use a toast for a message that must be acknowledged — that is a Modal; or for one attached to a surface — that is a Banner.",
    "Do not set priority high for routine confirmations; an assertive announcement interrupts whatever the reader was in the middle of.",
    "Do not put a second action in a toast. One action plus Close is the whole vocabulary; more is a dialog.",
    "Do not import Base UI's Toast directly for custom internals — compose a request to design instead (the per-toast anatomy is deliberately not public API).",
  ],

  a11y: {
    role: "The viewport is a landmark region (Base UI), named by `label`; each toast announces via the manager's live region.",
    name: "Viewport: `label` (required). Close buttons: `dismissLabel` (required). Both required at the type level because an unnamed landmark and a nameless icon button are the two failures nothing visual ever catches.",
    keyboard: [
      { key: "F6", does: "Moves focus into the toast viewport; the stack expands and timers pause while focus is inside." },
      { key: "Tab", does: "Walks the focused toast's controls — action, then close." },
      { key: "Enter / Space", does: "Activates the focused control — native, both are real buttons." },
      { key: "Escape", does: "Closes the focused toast (Base UI behaviour; asserted in Chromium — F6, Tab into the toast, Escape, gone)." },
    ],
    contrastPairs: [
      { fg: "--ui-text-primary", bg: "--ui-bg-elevated", floor: "text", role: "the title — 15.53:1 light / 11.20:1 dark" },
      { fg: "--ui-text-muted", bg: "--ui-bg-elevated", floor: "text", role: "the description, the Close glyph and the loading spinner — 5.36:1 light / 5.78:1 dark" },
      { fg: "--ui-intent-info-fg", bg: "--ui-bg-elevated", floor: "non-text", role: "the info glyph — 5.39:1 light / 8.18:1 dark; the glyph is the only channel carrying the type (SC 1.4.11)" },
      { fg: "--ui-intent-success-fg", bg: "--ui-bg-elevated", floor: "non-text", role: "the success glyph — 5.62:1 light / 8.26:1 dark" },
      { fg: "--ui-intent-warning-fg", bg: "--ui-bg-elevated", floor: "non-text", role: "the warning glyph — 5.48:1 light / 7.23:1 dark" },
      { fg: "--ui-intent-danger-fg", bg: "--ui-bg-elevated", floor: "non-text", role: "the danger glyph — 5.38:1 light / 8.56:1 dark" },
      { fg: "--ui-bg-elevated", bg: "--ui-bg-base", floor: "decorative", role: "the toast against the page", why: "the boundary is the border-subtle hairline plus shadow-lg, not the fill (ADR 0010); in dark the fill sits below the page ground and the hairline is a 14%-alpha light line" },
    ],
    dismissal: "Timeout (paused on hover/focus/window blur), the Close button, Escape from within, or a swipe down/right. Toasts over the limit are hidden but stay mounted and inert rather than being destroyed under a screen reader.",
  },

  forwarding: {
    "Toast.Viewport": "className and remaining div props land on the viewport element (the outermost node this component owns). label → aria-label; dismissLabel is threaded to every toast's close button. No refs are exposed — there is no stable per-toast node to hold one on.",
  },

  motion:
    "Enter from translateY(150%) + fade; exit reverses toward the bottom edge, or along the swipe axis after a swipe. Transforms run duration-enter with ease-spring (the sheet's motion-choreographed pair), opacity on duration-slow, the stack's height settle on duration-fast — written as longhand transition properties because the split cannot be expressed in one shorthand. Behind-content cross-fades on duration-base. The loading spinner is animate-spin with the motion-reduce guard; every transition collapses under prefers-reduced-motion at the token layer.",

  needsDesign: [
    "Anchored toasts (Base UI's Toast.Positioner — transient 'Copied' chips on a trigger) are out of scope for the sheet and this component; they need their own design pass if a consumer asks.",
    "A shared Spinner primitive: loading reuses Button's private border-drawn spinner recipe for the third time. Three copies is the chrome-control story again.",
  ],

  knownGaps: [
    "The toast width reuses --ui-dialog-width-md (416px) — recorded as a Conflict on the sheet: if Toast should ever size independently of Modal, a --ui-toast-width token must be minted first.",
    "No global manager outside React (Base UI's createToastManager). All twelve measured call sites fire from components; add the wrapper when one does not.",
    "Exit-while-expanded uses the collapsed exit transform (the Base UI demo duplicates every ending transform under data-expanded; this component does not) — visible only when a toast times out at the exact moment the pointer is over the stack.",
    "swipeDirection is fixed to Base UI's default (down, right), matching the bottom-right placement; a viewport placement prop would need the sheet's Custom position pass first.",
  ],

  design: "https://app.paper.design/file/01KZ39A2BC286MT85M658NRR4R/4-0/2D9X-0",
} as const;

export type ToastDoc = typeof toastDoc;
